description: Familiar Duda, Squarespace, and Elementor visual editing for local websites, with precise Codex code handoff.

defaultPrompt: Add Visual Truth to this React project and open the editor.
Let me adjust this page visually, then make it durable code.
Compare this page at desktop, iPad, and phone sizes.
interface.longDescription: Visual Truth adds a development-only editor to compatible React websites with switchable Duda, Squarespace, and Elementor workspaces. It keeps the canvas focused with top-layer editor chrome, direct Text + box or Box only resizing, 1/5/10px precision controls, semantic Layers, responsive scopes, ruler guides, smart actions, multi-selection, reusable components, data binding, opt-in privacy-first feedback, exact styling, and reviewable Make It Code output without shipping the editor overlay.

name: visual-truth
